name: Otherside Clean

band.style_feel: mid-tempo straight eighths, steady kick and snare, restrained in the verse, fuller in the chorus
parts: Part A: intro/verse - sparse drums, clean arpeggios
Part B: chorus - full band, open and driving
band.tips: Play the intro riff 2 bars cleanly before it starts learning; keep strumming steady and lock to the 123 BPM click. Sources vary 120-126 BPM, so adjust by ear.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E), not verified
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E).
whammy.tips: Could not verify the recording's tuning or any whammy/octave part; a web search found no source for either. Assumed standard tuning with no pitch effect. If your ear says the recording sits slightly flat, tune by ear to the track.

memo: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Otherside: verse arpeggios. Clean Marshall-ish tone with CE-1 style chorus, light room.

name: Otherside Crunch
memo: Red Hot Chili Peppers - Otherside: chorus/outro. Marshall Super Bass style crunch, chorus off.
